versions.changelog:
- Fixed links for reference material to point to the correct locations (e.g., self-defining-memories.md → elicitation/self-defining-memories.md).
- No other content changes; the core skill description and framework remain the same.

Initial release introducing psychological elicitation techniques for deep, authentic self-disclosure:

- Synthesizes research from narrative identity (McAdams), self-defining memories (Singer), and Motivational Interviewing (OARS framework)
- Emphasizes core principle: "Depth comes from patience, not probing"
- Provides practical conversational frames to elicit formative memories and life story themes
- Details reflection-centric interviewing techniques (2:1 reflections-to-questions ratio)
- Includes scoring rubric (0–10) and feedback loop for iterating on content and conversations
- Designed for psychological profiling, research, user interviews, and personal discovery contexts
